# Copilot Instructions — Autonomous Job Application Agent

> Generated by the doc-and-modernize skill (Modernization mode) as an editable
> starting point. Tune the gates/commands/branch rules as the project evolves.

Autonomous Job Application Agent is being **modernized** with a single,
proportionate phase: pin dependencies, collect the four existing `demo()`
self-checks into a real `pytest` suite, and stand up CI. The system is already
healthy — this is not a legacy rescue. It sits at the **Testability Milestone**
today (installs, builds, boots) except for a committed lockfile and a wired-up
test runner; those are closed in Phase 1, which is also the **CI Milestone**.
Safety rung target: **L3 (partial gate)** — deterministic-logic tests + lint in
CI; LLM-integration and live-scraping paths stay quarantined (manual smoke test
only), by deliberate economic-triage choice, not failure. See
`MODERNIZATION_PLAN.md` for the full phase and `ARCHITECTURE.md` for the
audited current state. Preserve the project's core safety invariant in every
change: dry-run stays the default, and live mode must keep requiring a typed
`SUBMIT` confirmation before opening a listing — never add auto-fill or
auto-submit against a third-party site.

## Commands

> Fill in once Phase 1 lands. Until then, the pre-migration commands are pip-based.

| Action | Command (pre-Phase-1) | Command (post-Phase-1) |
|--------|------------------------|-------------------------|
| Install deps | `pip install -r requirements.txt` then `pip install --no-deps python-jobspy` | `uv sync --frozen` |
| Run | `streamlit run app.py` | `uv run streamlit run app.py` |
| Unit tests (all) | none exist | `uv run pytest` |
| Single test file | none | `uv run pytest tests/test_<name>.py` |
| Lint | none | `uv run ruff check .` |
| Format check | none | `uv run ruff format --check .` |
| Typecheck | not planned | not planned (no typecheck tool adopted in Phase 1) |
| End-to-end / smoke | manual only (see CONTRIBUTING.md) | manual only — LLM/scraping paths are deliberately not in CI |

CI (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`, once authored) runs `ruff check → pytest` on
Python 3.13 for every push/PR to `main`. CI is stood up in **Phase 1** (the
first and only lit phase). **Enforcement is a separate manual step:** until a
human adds this workflow as a required status check under GitHub → Settings →
Branches, CI *runs* on PRs but does not *block* merges.

> **Keep this table current.** If a later change introduces a new long-term
> command, update this table.

## Phase gating (regime-aware)

A phase is not complete until its Verification & Exit Criteria in
`MODERNIZATION_PLAN.md` pass, are actually executed and recorded, and gate
advancement to the next phase. Phase 1 here is post-testability ("lit") from
the start — exit on runnable commands / green CI, not a safety-ladder snapshot.

## Decisions

- All of Phase 1's sub-decisions are already resolved in `MODERNIZATION_PLAN.md`
  § 6 ("Decisions made") — no further user input should be needed to execute it.
- Update `MODERNIZATION_PLAN.md` status markers (✅/⏭️/🗑️) as Phase 1's exit
  criteria are met.

## Branching & PRs

Single-phase plan: branch `modernize/tooling-and-ci` from `main`, one PR back
to `main`, merge on green CI. No sibling-phase stacking risk. `main` is the
only branch in this repo — no legacy default branch to avoid targeting.

**Keep the executable docs alive with the code.** This phase changes topology
(new `pyproject.toml`/`uv.lock`, removed `requirements.txt`, new `tests/`, new
CI workflow) — update `README.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, and `run.cmd` in the
**same PR** (already tasks 1.7-1.9 in `MODERNIZATION_PLAN.md`).

**No transitional-insecure states** are introduced by this phase — nothing to
register.

> **CI enforcement is a manual, human-only step.** Authoring
> `.github/workflows/ci.yml` is agent-doable; making it a required status check
> is a GitHub Settings action only a human can perform.
